Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package io.github.leetcode.strings;

public class ReplaceAllToAvoidConsecutiveRepeatingCharacters {

    public String modifyString(String s) {
        String ns = "";
        int n = s.length();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!Character.isAlphabetic(s.charAt(i))) {
                char c = 'a';
                while ((i + 1 < n && c == s.charAt(i + 1)) || (i - 1 >= 0 && c == ns.charAt(i - 1))) {
                    c = (char) (c + 1);
                }
                ns = ns + c;
            } else {
                ns = ns + s.charAt(i);
            }
        }

        return ns;
    }

}
